column3: NKJV adds “and whoever marries her who is divorced commits adultery,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with the first “commits adultery.”
NKJV has “Good Teacher,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “Teacher.”
NKJV follows the Textus Receptus: “Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God.” The critical text reads “Why do you ask Me about what is good? There is One who is good.”
NKJV includes “from my youth,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “All these I have kept.”
NKJV includes “or wife,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
